app.name: PLAYNEX
app.tagline: Play in the browser, keep your score.

common.notificationsEmpty: No notifications yet. Friend requests and record alerts will show up here.

home.title: PLAYNEX arcade
home.popularHint: Games you can play right now

rankingEmpty.title: The ranking is still empty
rankingEmpty.description: Once scores are verified on the server, the first placings will appear here.

account.label: Account summary
account.guestBody: You can play as a guest. With an account, your scores stay on your profile and enter the ranking.

empty.title: No games match these filters
empty.description: Change the search or clear the filters to see the whole catalog.

game.comingSoonNotice: This game cannot be played yet. It will show up here when it launches.

empty.title: No scores yet
empty.description: There are no verified scores in this window. Be the first.

emptyHistory.title: No game history yet
emptyHistory.description: Scores show up here once you finish your first game.

profile.welcome: Your account is ready, {name}. Your records now travel with you.

brand.title: Put your name on the score.
brand.body: One account for every game: your records build up on your profile, you take your place in the ranking and show up by name in online rooms.

register.title: Create your account
register.lead: It takes a minute. Then you confirm it with the 6-digit code we email you.
register.usernameHint: 3–20 characters; letters, digits, underscore and dot.
register.emailHint: The verification code goes to this address.
register.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A long sentence makes a good password.
register.privacy: Other players only see your username, first name and last-name initial.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.lead: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It is valid for 15 minutes.
verify.codeHint: If it has not arrived, check your spam folder too.
verify.resent: We sent you a new code.
verify.mailFailed: We could not send the code just now. Try sending a new one in a moment.

login.title: Welcome back
login.lead: Sign in with your username or email.
login.resetDone: Your password is updated. Sign in with the new one.

errors.invalid_input: Fix the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.invalid_code: That code does not match. Check the digits and try again.
errors.code_expired: The code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong attempts. Ask for a new code.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds}s.
errors.unavailable: We cannot reach the server right now. Try again shortly.
errors.account_suspended: This account is suspended. If you think this is a mistake, get in touch with us.

username.format: Start with a letter or digit; use only letters, digits, _ and .

email.taken: An account already uses this email.

firstName.length: Enter your first name (up to 50 characters).
firstName.format: The first name contains invalid characters.

lastName.length: Enter your last name (up to 50 characters).
lastName.format: The last name contains invalid characters.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: Enter the email on your account and we will send a 6-digit code to set a new password.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.lead: If {email} has an account, we sent it a 6-digit code. It is valid for 15 minutes.
reset.codeHint: No code? Check your spam folder too.
reset.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Changing it signs you out on other devices.

loginCode.title: Enter your sign-in code
loginCode.lead: We sent a 6-digit sign-in code to {email}. It is valid for 15 minutes.
loginCode.codeHint: If it has not arrived, check your spam folder too.
loginCode.resent: We sent you a new code.
loginCode.expired: This sign-in attempt has expired. Sign in with your password again.

player.localBestNote: Best score is stored in this browser; account sync is coming.

paused.title: Paused
paused.hint: Take a breath. The score is waiting.

error.title: The game could not load
error.description: Something went wrong. You can try again without reloading the page.

lobby.title: How do you want to play?

solo.title: On your own
solo.hint: Against the computer or the clock, at your own pace.

local.title: Same device
local.hint: Share the screen and take turns or play side by side.

online.title: Online room
online.hint: Share a code and friends join from their own devices.

online.nicknameHint: 2–16 characters; everyone in the room sees it.
online.closed: Could not reach the server. Try again in a moment.
online.waitingHost: The host starts the match once everyone is ready.
online.waitingReady: Waiting for the other players to get ready.
online.needPlayers: This game needs at least {min} players.

errors.room_not_found: No open room with that code.
errors.room_in_progress: A match is running in this room; try again when it ends.
errors.room_closed: The room closed after being idle for too long.
errors.server_busy: The server is very busy right now. Try again shortly.
errors.invalid_nickname: Nicknames need 2–16 characters and no special symbols.
errors.not_ready: The match cannot start until everyone is ready.
errors.player_count: The number of players does not fit this game.
errors.not_host: Only the host can start the match.

reasons.repetition: The same position came up three times.
reasons.timeoutInsufficient: Out of time, but the opponent cannot mate.

forbidden.title: This page is for admins
forbidden.description: Your account cannot see this section. If you signed in with the wrong account, sign out and try again with an admin account.
forbidden.guestDescription: Only admin accounts can open this section. If you are an admin, sign in.

notFound.title: Nothing here
notFound.description: The page you are looking for may have moved or never existed.

generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.description: The page failed to load. Trying again usually works.

offline.title: No connection
offline.description: Scores cannot be saved; they will be sent automatically once you are back online.

overview.title: State of the arcade
overview.lead: Accounts, sessions and admin actions at a glance.

users.title: Players
users.lead: Search accounts, check their state and suspend them when needed.

empty.description: Change the search or the filter and try again.

actions.confirmSuspendBody: Their open sessions end right away, they cannot sign in and their profile is hidden. You can lift the suspension at any time.
actions.confirmGrantBody: Admins see this panel; they can suspend players and appoint other admins.

errors.cannot_target_self: You cannot do this to your own account.
errors.not_verified: An account without a verified email cannot be an admin.
errors.failed: That did not go through. Try again.

reports.title: Player reports
reports.lead: Open reports, newest first. Resolved or dismissed ones leave the list.

lobby.title: Siper
lobby.subtitle: Start right away against bots or join an online match.

modeHints.tdm: Respawn after 3 seconds; the first team to 50 kills wins.
modeHints.bomb: Raiders plant at site A or B, Wardens defuse. First to 7 rounds wins.
modeHints.knife: Knives only. Clear the other team to take the round; 5 rounds wins.
modeHints.ffa: Everyone against everyone; first to 25 kills wins.
modeHints.gungame: Your weapon changes every two kills; the last step is the knife.

lobby.botsNote: Bot matches need no account; signed in, they earn half XP and leave your rating alone.
lobby.startingBots: The bots are taking their places…
lobby.offline: Could not reach the server. Reload and try again.
lobby.accountBody: Other players see your username, and results go to your profile and the leaderboard.
lobby.noRooms: No open rooms right now. Quick match opens a new one.
lobby.partyJoinLabel: Party code (leave empty to start one)
lobby.partyHint: When the leader quick-matches, the party follows onto the same team.
lobby.quickNext: The next match starts in a few seconds.
lobby.equalTeams: Without bots, the match only starts with even teams.

errors.account_required: You need to sign in for this.
errors.invalid_ticket: Your session could not be verified. Reload the page.
errors.teams_uneven: Teams are uneven. Someone should switch, or turn bots on.
errors.room_in_progress: The match is running and has no free seat.
errors.server_busy: The server is busy, try again shortly.
